name: Files Studio
description: A unified file workspace for local folders, S3-compatible storage, Azure Blob, Google Cloud Storage, Huawei OBS, WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, SMB/CIFS, and other OpenDAL services.
releaseNotes: 新增工具栏「上传文件夹」：走 webview 原生 webkitdirectory 选择器（web/docker 与桌面宿主同一路径），按相对路径还原目录结构落到 目标/<文件夹名>/；先建远端目录树（目录已存在=合并），再逐文件走统一上传泵；同名冲突策略按子目录分组生效（询问档带目录前缀、自动重命名在目录内让位）。目录结构与落盘内容均有集成测试覆盖。New toolbar action "Upload folder": a webview-native webkitdirectory picker (same path on web/docker and desktop hosts) that restores the directory structure under target/<folder>/, creates the remote directory tree first (existing dirs merge), then streams every file through the unified upload pump; the conflict policy applies per subdirectory (ask shows dir-prefixed names, rename de-dupes within each directory).

zh-CN.name: Files Studio
zh-CN.description: 统一管理本地文件夹、S3 兼容存储、Azure Blob、Google Cloud Storage、华为 OBS、WebDAV、FTP、SFTP、SMB/CIFS 等 OpenDAL 服务的文件工作台：传输任务、归档与受控运维集中在一个界面。
